steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We've managed to save all the injured civilians. There's still one Sinner out there, fighting alone in the lockdown zone.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: I've got the intel. Everyone, beef up our defenses, reorganize our forces, and get ready to join me in the fray!!

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Also, we've found the MBCC Sinner who went missing. She's in urgent need of medical care. Get in touch with the Bureau, stat!!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Captain! That young Sinner, she's disappeared!

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: What are you talking about?
The gravely wounded old man slowly comes to, his gaze lingering in the direction Hecate had departed.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Hecate... Come back...
Hecate, on her own, clings to the White Cube as she races, tripping over herself.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I broke free from FAC's grip, even though I once obeyed their every command. But why?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Did I do this because I trusted someone, believed in someone outside of my mission? Is this really the right choice?

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Be extra careful when you are on your own. Make it out alive and return safely to the ones who matter the most to you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The one who matters most... Chief! I want to see Chief.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But where should I go and what should I do now? Why there is no one giving me a mission? Please, somebody tell me what to do!
Her mind whirls with thoughts, the foremost being Paradeisos's notice. They said they have news regarding Chief, mentioning ${PlayerName} is at the Exiles' Base.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Oh right, the base...
The base hadn't exactly been a haven for Hecate, but now she feels an overwhelming urge to return, almost as if it is her only hope for salvation.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Stop selling yourself short, and forget about needing "someone stronger." You're strong in your own right, and there's plenty out there ready to back you up. You've never been the underdog.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You don't need to trust me. But you should find someone you can trust. Don't isolate yourself. You've already pushed your mind to the breaking point.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella is there... Matilda, Lavina, and countless others are there. I've got to find them...

She dashes ahead, her steps as erratic and unsteady as a child lost in thought. Just a few paces in, several figures lunge out of nowhere, tripping her. Hecate, already teetering on the brink of panic, reacts with a startled gasp.

steps.speaker: Fleeing Child
steps.content: Sobbing... Mommy, Daddy... where are you...

steps.speaker: Fleeing Child
steps.content: Missy, please help me. I'm scared. Don't leave me here, I'm really scared...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Huff... I wasn't given the mission of helping you. I'm running out of time; I need to save Chief...

Attempting to distance herself from the children, she realizes that this act only heightens their fear, leading to more intense sobbing. This cacophony of cries further muddles Hecate's thoughts, making her feel as though she is facing a mirror image of herself.

steps.speaker: Fleeing Child
steps.content: Sob... What should I do?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...There's no order... for me to follow...
What's the right move here? She's on her own, at a loss for what to do next.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You've got to decide for yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This time, it's my turn to protect you...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ... Nightmare!!
Finally, the young girl manages to push the weeping children away. Her body shakes, struggling to catch her breath, and she eventually finds her voice and cries out.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Stay Here! Keep them safe!
Nightmare lingers in the wake, soon to be displaced by FAC soldiers coming to whisk the kids away.
Hecate, on her own, sprints down the streets—no Nightmare for protection, no one to lead her way. She tears through Syndicate's alleys.
Just a stone's throw away, another team has recently pulled out of the Exiles' Base, heading in a direction contrary to Hecate's path.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We've fallen into a trap. Without the insights of the Second Observatorium, we can't track the evolving group consciousness in the area. Instead, we're being used by the Underground powers to stir up the Mania in the Black Ring. Losing X is a massive setback.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The advance team is back at base, reporting erratic movements in the Black Ring. Time to rethink our approach.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...You've had your eyes on the streets; spotted anything unusual?

steps.speaker: Paradeisos Elite
steps.content: ...Hmm.
The elite soldier instantly notices a girl, clearly a Sinner, stumbling and sprinting through the streets, her body emanating unnaturally sharp, black spikes that catch the eye.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Hecate? What brought you back?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You're heavily contaminated; you need immediate treatment.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Where's Chief?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: He's not here. This is all a scheme by the Underground, a trap to lure Paradeisos into attacking us and to stir up unrest.
steps.female_content: She's not here. This is all a scheme by the Underground, a trap to lure Paradeisos into attacking us and to stir up unrest.

steps.content: Hecate is briefly overwhelmed and can't take in the information, but the sight of Hella, deep in contamination, hits her hard. Her friend's pain feels almost tangible to her.
She quickly grabs the White Cube and places it on Hella, hoping for a miracle—for a moment, she forgets that it was actually designed to save ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, please, wake up... I'm so sorry, this is all on me, I'm truly sorry...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief... Chief, where are you... I'm begging you... please respond...
Dark spikes of light slowly appear, but this time, a faint, wavering voice drifts out from the turmoil of the contamination.
You know where he's at...
Retrieve your shackles; you can sense them...
Find him, he's waiting for you, he relies on you... I'll deal with the obstacles in the way for you...
steps.female_content: Find her, she's waiting for you, she relies on you... I'll deal with the obstacles in the way for you...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You are...?
Go... It's all on you now...
The chaos from the other end of the shackles momentarily vanishes, as if someone parted the sea of Mania that drowns everything, at last revealing the truth hidden beneath the chaos.
In that split second, she sees the person at the very end of the shackles.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I... I've figured out where Chief is... I want to go. I need to—

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Go for it! You've got me here. I swear, Hella won't suffer a scratch as long as I'm here.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Work as a team, and make sure you bring that person back in one piece. Caution is key!

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The Black Ring has erupted, marking this path with Corruptors. It's too dangerous out there.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I'll come with you.
